items.title: 68087_Cliff Leeman oral history interview
items.q: The others, I believe -- if I recall, were Vic Dickenson, Joe Venuti, Jess Stacey, Milt Gabler and John S. Wilson, eminent music critic of the New York Times, was on the nominating committee

ctx.x: Anyway, the plaque reads "New Jersey Jazz Society to Cliff Leeman, a musician among drummers, his playing has enriched the jazz heritage immensely, providing a standard by which others must be judged. The award is presented by

the New Jersey Jazz Society, February 12, 1978."
Up until that date, I was the fourth musician so honored. The others, I believe -- if I recall, were Vic Dickenson, Joe Venuti, Jess Stacey, Milt Gabler and John S. Wilson, eminent music critic of the New York Times, was on the nominating committee, and I am grateful to them.
To me, that's my Oscar. I started to say, also, this year Wild Bill Davison had been so honored, and he will be over here from Europe -- he lives in Denmark -- Copenhagen, and I will be in…

I was the guest instrumentalist. I should say guest performer with a local group which was just wonderful, and I had a wonderful day reminiscing with a gang of old friends whom I hadn't seen for 40 or 50 years.
